chunks: From him, from Safwan, from al-'Ala', from Ibn Abi Ya'fur; and Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Humran, from Ibn Abi Ya'fur, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about the two rak'ahs of al-fajr: when should I perform them? He said: Before al-fajr, with it, and after it.

key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ: the two units of prayer associated with dawn

ai.seo_question: When can the two rak'ahs of al-fajr be performed according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the time of performing the two rak'ahs of al-fajr. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that they may be performed before dawn, along with it, or after it, indicating flexibility in their timing.
